symfony/cache, predis/predis, paragonie/halite, league/flysystem, ezyang/htmlpurifier

9. CQRS — Command/Query separation (ADR-084)

11. DDD: Aggregate Root, Entity, Value Object, Domain Event patterns
12. SOLID: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion
13. Clean Architecture: Controller -> Use Case -> Repository (never Controller -> Repository directly)
14. Middleware Pipeline (frozen order): OriginCheck -> Cors -> RateLimiter -> SecurityHeaders -> SessionManager -> Csrf -> BypassAuth -> Auth -> Permission -> Validation

PATTERN: Repository pattern, strict constructor injection, final classes, DDD, CQRS.

=== ZERO-ALLOCATION RULES ===
FORBIDDEN in audio thread: malloc, free, new, delete, std::make_shared, std::vector push_back, I/O blocking, throw
ALLOWED: Stack allocation, std::atomic, SIMD (SSE2/AVX2/NEON), constexpr, alignas(64), SPSC ring buffer
Pre-allocation: All buffers allocated before audio thread starts. Audio thread uses only existing buffers.

=== LOCK-FREE RULES ===
FORBIDDEN: std::mutex, lock_guard, unique_lock, condition_variable, semaphore
ALLOWED: std::atomic, progressive back-off spinlock, SPSC ring buffer, immutable data structures
Memory order: parameter update = relaxed, data publish = release/acquire, spinlock = acquire/release

=== DSP CHAIN ===
Input Buffer -> Gain -> EQ (31-band parametric) -> Compressor -> Limiter -> Crossover -> Output Buffer
Input/Output: Float32 ([-1.0, 1.0]), 48kHz, 512 samples default (~10.67ms)

=== HARD GUARDRAILS ===
1. Zero-allocation: malloc/new/delete FORBIDDEN in audio thread
2. Lock-free: mutex/lock_guard/unique_lock FORBIDDEN in audio thread
3. noexcept mandatory on audio callbacks (processBlock)
4. constexpr for compile-time calculations
5. alignas(64) for cache-line alignment (false sharing prevention)
6. PCM5122 ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN — only PCM3168A (8-ch) — ADR-038 H001 RED
7. 32-bit float for audio data — ADR-017
8. 512 sample buffer default, 48kHz sample rate — ADR-017
9. ASIO Exclusive Lock: same time only ONE application
10. DC Offset >0.5V -> protection relay mandatory
11. Thread priority: audio thread = THREAD_PRIORITY_TIME_CRITICAL
12. writeHead/readHead: alignas(64) std::atomic<size_t>

STACK: C++20, JUCE 9, ASIO SDK 2.3.4, XMOS XU316, PCM3168A, 8.1 surround.
PLATFORM: Windows Tier 1, Linux Tier 2, macOS Tier 3, RPi5 Tier 4.
